children: LME copper (MCU3=LX) may test resistance at $14,527 per metric ton this week, a break above which could lead to a gain to $14,888.

A channel technique indicates a target around $14,600, while a projection analysis suggests a higher target of $15,473, subject to a break above $14,527, as a wave c from $12,997 can extend to $15,473, its 100% projection level.
Support is at $14,235, a break below which may be followed by a drop to $13,943.
* The copper report is published weekly on Monday.
